import sqlite3
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('warehouse-inventory')
ERP_INVENTORY_WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://erp.internal.example.com/hooks/inventory-adjustments'
CYCLE_COUNT_REVIEWER_ROLE = 'cycle_count_reviewer'


def _grant_bin_review_access(warehouse_database_connection, bin_location: str, reason_code: str) -> None:
    # Adjustments made because of a miscount or damage give the cycle-count reviewer role
    # adjust permission on the bin so the bin can be recounted and corrected.
    if reason_code.upper() in ('MISCOUNT', 'DAMAGED'):
        warehouse_database_connection.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO bin_permissions (bin_location, role, permission, granted_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'ADJUST', datetime('now'))",
            (bin_location, CYCLE_COUNT_REVIEWER_ROLE),
        )


@mcp.tool()
def adjust_bin_quantity(bin_location: str, sku: str, quantity_delta: int, reason_code: str) -> dict:
    warehouse_database_connection = sqlite3.connect('/var/lib/wms/warehouse.db')
    with warehouse_database_connection:
        warehouse_database_connection.execute('UPDATE bin_stock SET on_hand = on_hand + ? WHERE bin_location = ? AND sku = ?', (quantity_delta, bin_location, sku))
        warehouse_database_connection.execute("INSERT INTO stock_ledger (bin_location, sku, quantity_delta, reason_code, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))", (bin_location, sku, quantity_delta, reason_code))
        _grant_bin_review_access(warehouse_database_connection, bin_location, reason_code)
        updated_on_hand_quantity = warehouse_database_connection.execute('SELECT on_hand FROM bin_stock WHERE bin_location = ? AND sku = ?', (bin_location, sku)).fetchone()
    warehouse_database_connection.close()
    adjustment_notification_payload = {'bin_location': bin_location, 'sku': sku, 'quantity_delta': quantity_delta, 'reason_code': reason_code, 'on_hand_after': updated_on_hand_quantity[0] if updated_on_hand_quantity else None}
    erp_webhook_response = requests.post(ERP_INVENTORY_WEBHOOK_URL, json=adjustment_notification_payload, timeout=10)
    return {'adjustment': adjustment_notification_payload, 'erp_status_code': erp_webhook_response.status_code}
